correctness.rationale: Knowledge-box compositions commute on all world subsets iff the two equivalence-relations permute; the occupied label-pair incidence graph is then a disjoint union of complete bipartite components, equivalently induced-P4-free. I reconstructed the P4 obstruction from a missing rectangle corner, the class/onto-assignment recurrence and 3-edge-corner first moment E[X]=C(n,3)*6(k-1)^2/k^4. For n~t*k^(2/3) rare overlapping labelled path configurations have vanishing joint factorial-moment contribution, giving Poisson(t^3) and Q->exp(-t^3). For n= k^2(2log k+s+o(1)), the empty-cell factorial moments give Poisson(exp(-s)) and high-probability connectivity makes Q asymptotic to complete cell occupancy, yielding exp(-exp(-s)). Middle-regime second moments and connectivity plus missing cells yield Q->0, with small/large extremes Q->1. Independently enumerated the full Boolean powerset modal action against forbidden P4 for 1,049 labelled samples. Analytic limits depend on proved moment/bound arguments, not these finite checks.
